description: This PHP class defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for representing dependents related to an employee in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for converting the dependent data to an array and specifying how to retrieve fields from the Employee entity.

classes.name: Dependent
classes.description: A DTO representing an employee's dependent for reporting purposes, extending NormalizableDTO and including methods to facilitate normalization and data retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Dependent DTO with the employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the dependents related to the employee into an array format based on specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Returns a mapping of fields to getter methods used for normalizing dependent data.
